chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.enab: Th' cap'n's switch. When false, the vanilla Anvil region files be used unchanged. Turnin' this off does NOT convert anythin': existin' .cso files stay on disk, an' chunks stored only in 'em be invisible t' the vanilla reader.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.grid: Th' bucket grid's edge length. A 32x32 region be split into grid x grid buckets. Bigger grid = smaller buckets = less write amplification but weaker compression. Only applies t' newly created region files; existin' files keep their own grid. Measured on an 889 MB city save: grid 16 roughly halves th' write volume an' write time versus grid 8, fer about 7.5% more space. Grid 32 be worse than 16 - one chunk per bucket loses th' benefit o' sharin' a compression context. 1 = th' whole region be one bucket (best ratio, worst write cost; cold archives). 8 = 16 chunks per bucket. 16 = 4 chunks per bucket (default: lowest write cost).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.zstd: Th' zstd level fer th' hot write path. 3 be th' default trade-off; higher levels squeeze better an' write slower.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.cach: Decompressed buckets kept in th' hold (memory) per region file. Higher values reduce read amplification near th' player, at th' cost o' heap. Th' cache also be bounded by an 8 MB per-file budget — at small grids a single bucket can hold a whole region's worth o' chunks, an' one bigger than th' budget be not cached at all. A bucket holds up to (32/grid)^2 chunks; at grid=8 that be 16 chunks.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.veri: Inspect each bucket's CRC32 when readin'. Detects rot instead o' silently returnin' garbage or empty chunks. Keep this on unless ye be benchmarkin'.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.fall: When a chunk be absent from th' .cso file, sail back t' readin' th' legacy .mca. This makes th' mod safe t' enable on an existin' world: nothin' already saved be lost, an' new writes gradually move t' th' new format.
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.comp: Th' minimum wasted bytes before a region file gets stowed tight.
Minimum wasted/live ratio before stowin' kicks in (0.25 = 25% waste).
chunkstorageoptimizer.configuration.batc: Writin' one chunk means recompressin' its whole bucket, so writes be staged an' flushed per bucket: N chunks in one bucket cost one compression, not N. This be how many chunks t' stage in yer net before flushin' early. Set t' 1 t' disable batchin'.
Maximum time staged writes may sit in th' hold before bein' forced t' disk. Bounds how much be lost if th' process goes down with all hands. Autosave flushes regardless.
